panels.description: Estimated user-facing request rate. Computed as total frontend requests minus internal peer-hop requests to backends named varnish_*.
panels.title: External Requests

panels.description: Requests sent from Varnish to the Drupal origin backend only (backend=drupal). Excludes inter-node Varnish traffic.
panels.title: Origin Requests

panels.description: Share of external requests served without going to origin. Formula: 1 - (origin requests / external requests). Higher is better.
panels.title: Origin Offload Ratio

panels.description: Ratio of internal Varnish-to-Varnish forwarding traffic. Formula: peer-hop backend requests (backend=varnish_*) divided by total frontend requests.
panels.title: Peer Hop Ratio

panels.description: Compares legacy hit ratio (cache_hit/(cache_hit+cache_miss)) with a cluster-aware ratio (1 - origin/external). In clustered Varnish, cluster-aware better reflects user-visible cache effectiveness.
panels.title: Requests

panels.description: Current mempool occupancy per mempool id: objects in use and currently retained in the pool.
panels.title: Mempool occupancy

panels.description: Requested versus actually allocated bytes for each mempool id.
panels.title: Mempool allocation size

panels.description: Mempool churn and pressure events per mempool id, shown as per-second rates over 5 minutes.
panels.title: Mempool churn

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m])), 1e-9)

100 * sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",container!="",container!="POD"}) / clamp_min((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",resource="memory",unit="byte",container!=""})) or (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",resource="memory",unit="byte",container!=""})), 1e-9)

panels.description: Per-container memory working set as a percentage of configured memory limit. Falls back to memory request when limit is not set.
panels.title: Memory usage (%)
